correctness.rationale: Two independent algorithms agree on all 449153 faces, including empty. The first matching pairs 224409 nonempty-face incidences and leaves (critical 0,3,4)=(1,138,195); the entire directed Hasse graph of 449152 nodes and 3225264 incidences is acyclic by exhaustive topological sorting. Signed gradient-path recursion reconstructs the exact stored 138-by-195 integral Morse matrix (3843 nonzero entries). 117 unit pivots and a 21-by-14 residual column Hermite basis with fourteen unit Smith factors give rank 131 with no torsion. A non-affine alternate matching has (1,117,174) critical cells and independently yields 105+5 unit invariant factors. Degree-vector classification of 4-cell attachments to a bouquet of 3-spheres gives the claimed wedge. Multiplication by 2 implements graph self-complementarity and the arXiv:2312.02639 Alexander duality gives the dominance integral homology.

value.rationale: The order-29 Paley graph is a canonical highly symmetric self-complementary strongly regular graph, making its integral neighborhood homotopy type a natural precise invariant. This complete wedge classification distinguishes it from the torsion-bearing order-17 neighborhood example and from the torsion-bearing independence/clique constructions on the same graph. The duality consequence also supplies the complete integral dominance homology. This is a motivated finite classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a claim about all Paley graphs.
